items.source: On an attribute of type String, long or Long, @Id can be used with @GeneratedValue. Long and long maps to the Neo4j internal id. String maps to the elementId that is available since Neo4j 5. Both are not a property on a node or relationship and usually not visible, to the attribute and allows SDN to retrieve individual instances of the class.
items.translation: 对于类型为 `String`、`long` 或 `Long` 的属性，可以结合使用 `@Id` 和 `@GeneratedValue`。 `Long` 和 `long` 映射到 Neo4j 的内部 ID。 `String` 则映射到自 Neo4j 5 版本起可用的 `elementId`。 两者均不是节点或关系上的属性，通常对用户不可见；该属性允许 SDN 检索类的单个实例。

items.source: @GeneratedValue provides the attribute generatorClass. generatorClass can be used to specify a class implementing IdGenerator. An IdGenerator is a functional interface and its generateId takes the primary label and the instance to generate an Id for. We support UUIDStringGenerator as one implementation out of the box.
items.translation:
@GeneratedValue 提供了 generatorClass 属性。  
generatorClass 可用于指定一个实现 IdGenerator 的类。  
IdGenerator 是一个函数式接口，其 generateId 方法接收主键标签和实例，用于生成 ID。  
我们开箱即用地支持 UUIDStringGenerator 作为其中一种实现。

items.source: Consider an example where a movie has actors, and you want to fetch a certain movie with all its actors. This won’t be problematical if the relationship from movie to actor were just unidirectional. In a bidirectional scenario SDN would fetch the particular movie, its actors but also the other movies defined for this actor per definition of the relationship. In the worst case, this will cascade to fetching the whole graph for a single entity.
items.translation: 考虑一个示例，其中一部电影拥有演员，而您希望获取某部特定电影及其所有演员。如果从电影到演员的关系仅仅是单向的，这便不会成为问题。但在双向关系场景中，SDN 在获取特定电影及其演员的同时，还会根据关系的定义获取该演员所关联的其他所有电影。在最坏的情况下，这将导致级联查询，最终为单个实体获取整个图数据。

items.source: All labels implicitly defined through the simple class name or explicitly via the @Node annotation are static. They cannot be changed during runtime. If you need additional labels that can be manipulated during runtime, you can use @DynamicLabels. @DynamicLabels is an annotation on field level and marks an attribute of type java.util.Collection<String> (a List or Set) for example) as source of dynamic labels.
items.translation: 所有通过简单类名隐式定义或通过 `@Node` 注解显式定义的标签都是静态的，无法在运行时更改。如果您需要可以在运行时操作的额外标签，可以使用 `@DynamicLabels`。@DynamicLabels 是一个字段级别的注解，它将类型为 java.util.Collection<String>（例如 List 或 Set）的属性标记为动态标签的来源。

items.source: @Node has an attribute labels that allows you to configure one or more labels to be used when reading and writing instances of the annotated class. The value attribute is an alias for labels. If you don’t specify a label, then the simple class name will be used as the primary label. In case you want to provide multiple labels, you could either:
items.translation:
`@Node` 注解拥有一个 `labels` 属性，允许您配置一个或多个标签，用于读取和写入该标注类的实例。  
`value` 属性是 `labels` 的别名。  
如果您未指定标签，则会将简单类名用作主标签。  
如果您需要提供多个标签，您可以选择以下任一方式：

items.source: If, e.g., two transactions in different threads want to modify the same object with version x, the first operation will get successfully persisted to the database. At this moment, the version field will get incremented, so it is x+1. The second operation will fail with a OptimisticLockingFailureException because it wants to modify the object with the version x that does not exist anymore in the database. In such cases the operation needs to get retried, beginning with a fresh fetch of the object with the current version from the database.
items.translation: 例如，如果两个不同线程中的事务都试图修改版本为 x 的同一对象，第一个操作将成功持久化到数据库中。此时，版本号字段会被递增，变为 x+1。第二个操作则会因尝试修改一个在数据库中已不存在的、版本号为 x 的对象而失败，抛出 OptimisticLockingFailureException 异常。在这种情况下，需要重新执行该操作，首先从数据库中获取当前版本的最新对象数据。

items.source: The type or the value attribute allow configuration of the relationship’s type, direction allows specifying the direction. The default direction in SDN is Relationship.Direction#OUTGOING.
items.translation: `type` 或 `value` 属性可用于配置关系的类型，而 `direction` 则用于指定方向。 SDN 中的默认方向为 `Relationship.Direction#OUTGOING`。

items.source: @org.springframework.data.annotation.Id same as @Id from SDN, in fact, @Id is annotated with Spring Data Common’s Id-annotation.
items.translation: @org.springframework.data.annotation.Id 与 SDN 中的 @Id 相同，实际上，@Id 是标注了 Spring Data Commons 的 Id 注解。

items.source: This is where @Id comes into play. @Id marks an attribute of the class to be the unique identifier of the object. That unique identifier is in an optimal world a unique business key or in other words, a natural key. @Id can be used on all attributes with a supported simple type.
items.translation: 这就是 `@Id` 发挥作用的地方。 `@Id` 用于标记类的属性，使其成为对象的唯一标识符。 在理想情况下，这个唯一标识符应是一个唯一的业务键，换句话说，即自然键。 `@Id` 可用于所有具有支持简单类型的属性。

items.source: You can also specify a Spring Bean from the application context on @GeneratedValue via generatorRef. That bean also needs to implement IdGenerator, but can make use of everything in the context, including the Neo4j client or template to interact with the database.
items.translation: 此外，您可以通过在 `@GeneratedValue` 中使用 `generatorRef` 指定应用程序上下文中的 Spring Bean。该 Bean 同样需要实现 `IdGenerator` 接口，但可以利用上下文中的所有资源，包括用于与数据库交互的 Neo4j 客户端或模板。

items.source: We support dynamic relationships. Dynamic relationships are represented as a Map<String, AnnotatedDomainClass> or Map<Enum, AnnotatedDomainClass>. In such a case, the type of the relationship to the other domain class is given by the maps key and must not be configured through the @Relationship.
items.translation: 我们支持动态关系。 动态关系表示为 `Map<String, AnnotatedDomainClass>` 或 `Map<Enum, AnnotatedDomainClass>`。 在这种情况下，与其他领域类的关系类型由 Map 的键给出，且不能通过 `@Relationship` 进行配置。

items.source: Neo4j supports defining properties not only on nodes but also on relationships. To express those properties in the model SDN provides @RelationshipProperties to be applied on a simple Java class. Within the properties class there have to be exactly one field marked as @TargetNode to define the entity the relationship points towards. Or, in an INCOMING relationship context, is coming from.
items.translation: Neo4j 支持不仅为节点定义属性，也为关系定义属性。 为了在模型中表达这些属性，SDN 提供了 `@RelationshipProperties`注解，可应用于一个简单的 Java 类。 在该属性类中，必须恰好有一个字段标记为 `@TargetNode`，用于定义关系所指向的实体；或者，在 `INCOMING` 关系的上下文中，表示该关系源自何处。

items.source: @GeneratedValue: Applied at the field level together with @Id to specify how unique identifiers should be generated.
items.translation: @GeneratedValue：与 @Id 一起应用于字段级别，用于指定如何生成唯一标识符。

items.source: @CompositeProperty: Applied at the field level on attributes of type Map that shall be read back as a composite. See Composite properties.
items.translation: @CompositeProperty：在类型为 Map 的属性字段级别应用，这些属性将以复合形式读回。参见复合属性。

items.source: @TargetNode: Applied on a field of a class annotated with @RelationshipProperties to mark the target of that relationship from the perspective of the other end.
items.translation: @TargetNode：应用于带有 @RelationshipProperties 注解的类的字段上，用于从另一端的角度标记该关系的目标。

items.source: Supply a value for primaryLabel and put the additional labels in labels.
items.translation: 为primaryLabel提供一个值，并将其他标签放入labels中。

items.source: The @Node annotation is not inherited from super-types and interfaces. You can however annotate your domain classes individually at every inheritance level. This allows polymorphic queries: You can pass in base or intermediate classes and retrieve the correct, concrete instance for your nodes. This is only supported for abstract bases annotated with @Node. The labels defined on such a class will be used as additional labels together with the labels of the concrete implementations.
items.translation: `@Node` 注解不会从父类型或接口中继承。不过，您可以在每个继承级别单独为领域类添加该注解。这支持多态查询：您可以传入基类或中间类，并检索到节点对应的正确具体实例。此功能仅支持带有 `@Node` 注解的抽象基类。在此类上定义的标签将与具体实现的标签一起作为附加标签使用。

items.source: Spring Data Neo4j supports optimistic locking by using the @Version annotation on a Long typed field. This attribute will get incremented automatically during updates and must not be manually modified.
items.translation: Spring Data Neo4j 通过在 `@Version` 注解的 `Long` 类型字段上使用该注解来支持乐观锁。此属性在更新时会自动递增，且不得手动修改。

items.source: The @Version attribute is also mandatory if business ids are used. Spring Data Neo4j will check this field to determine if the entity is new or has already been persisted before.
items.translation: 如果使用了业务标识符，则@Version属性也是强制要求的。Spring Data Neo4j 将检查该字段以确定实体是新创建的还是之前已经持久化过。

items.source: If you are working with an existing Neo4j schema or just like to adapt the mapping to your needs, you will need to use @Property. The name is used to specify the name of the property inside the database.
items.translation: 如果您正在使用现有的 Neo4j 模式，或者希望将映射自定义以适应您的需求，则需要使用@Property。 name用于指定数据库中属性的名称。

items.source: The @Relationship annotation can be used on all attributes that are not a simple type. It is applicable on attributes of other types annotated with @Node or collections and maps thereof.
items.translation: @Relationship 注解可用于所有非简单类型的属性。 它适用于其他带有 @Node 注解的类型属性，以及这些类型的集合和映射。

items.source: People are mapped in two roles here, actors and directors. The domain class is the same:
items.translation: 此处人员被映射为两个角色：actors 和 directors。 领域类是相同的：

items.source: To take full advantage of the object mapping functionality inside SDN, you should annotate your mapped objects with the @Node annotation. Although it is not necessary for the mapping framework to have this annotation (your POJOs are mapped correctly, even without any annotations), it lets the classpath scanner find and pre-process your domain objects to extract the necessary metadata. If you do not use this annotation, your application takes a slight performance hit the first time you store a domain object, because the mapping framework needs to build up its internal metadata model so that it knows about the properties of your domain object and how to persist them.
items.translation: 为了充分利用 SDN 内部的对象映射功能，您应该使用 @Node 注解来标记已映射的对象。 虽然映射框架并不需要此注解（即使没有任何注解，您的 POJO 也能被正确映射），但该注解可让类路径扫描器发现并预处理您的领域对象，从而提取必要的元数据。 如果您不使用此注解，在首次存储领域对象时，应用程序的性能会略有下降，因为映射框架需要构建其内部元数据模型，以便了解您领域对象的属性以及如何持久化它们。

items.source: @Node: Applied at the class level to indicate this class is a candidate for mapping to the database.
items.translation: @Node：在类级别应用，表示该类是数据库映射的候选者。

items.source: @Id: Applied at the field level to mark the field used for identity purpose.
items.translation: @Id：应用于字段级别，用于标记用于标识目的的字段。

items.source: @Property: Applied at the field level to modify the mapping from attributes to properties.
items.translation: @Property：应用于字段级别，用于修改从属性到属性的映射。

items.source: @Relationship: Applied at the field level to specify the details of a relationship.
items.translation: @Relationship：应用于字段级别，用于指定关系的详细信息。

items.source: @DynamicLabels: Applied at the field level to specify the source of dynamic labels.
items.translation: @DynamicLabels：应用于字段级别，用于指定动态标签的来源。

items.source: @RelationshipProperties: Applied at the class level to indicate this class as the target for properties of a relationship.
items.translation: @RelationshipProperties：在类级别应用，用于指示该类为关系属性的目标。

items.source: See Conversions for more information on that.
items.translation: 有关该主题的更多信息，请参阅转换。

items.source: @CreatedBy: Applied at the field level to indicate the creator of a node.
items.translation: @CreatedBy：应用于字段级别，用于指示节点的创建者。

items.source: @CreatedDate: Applied at the field level to indicate the creation date of a node.
items.translation: @CreatedDate：应用于字段级别，用于指示节点的创建日期。

items.source: @LastModifiedBy: Applied at the field level to indicate the author of the last change to a node.
items.translation: @LastModifiedBy：应用于字段级别，用于指示对节点进行最后一次修改的作者。

items.source: @LastModifiedDate: Applied at the field level to indicate the last modification date of a node.
items.translation: @LastModifiedDate：应用于字段级别，用于指示节点的最后修改日期。

items.source: @PersistenceCreator: Applied at one constructor to mark it as the preferred constructor when reading entities.
items.translation: @PersistenceCreator：应用于一个构造函数，以在读取实体时将其标记为首选构造函数。

items.source: @Persistent: Applied at the class level to indicate this class is a candidate for mapping to the database.
items.translation: @Persistent：在类级别应用，表示该类是数据库映射的候选者。

items.source: @Version: Applied at field level it is used for optimistic locking and checked for modification on save operations. The initial value is zero which is bumped automatically on every update.
items.translation: @Version：在字段级别应用时，用于乐观锁，并在保存操作时检查修改。初始值为零，每次更新时会自动递增。

items.source: @ReadOnlyProperty: Applied at field level to mark a property as read only. The property will be hydrated during database reads, but not be subject to writes. When used on relationships be aware that no related entity in that collection will be persisted if not related otherwise.
items.translation: @ReadOnlyProperty：在字段级别应用，用于将属性标记为只读。该属性会在数据库读取时进行水合（hydration），但不会接受写入操作。当将其用于关系时，请注意，如果该集合中的相关实体未通过其他方式建立关联，则这些实体不会被持久化。

items.source: Have a look at Auditing for all annotations regarding auditing support.
items.translation: 有关审计支持的所有注释，请查看审计。

items.source: The @Node annotation is used to mark a class as a managed domain class, subject to the classpath scanning by the mapping context.
items.translation: `@Node` 注解用于将类标记为受管理的领域类，使其接受映射上下文的类路径扫描。

items.source: Supply an array to the labels property. The first element in the array will be considered as the primary label.
items.translation: 向 `labels` 属性提供一个数组。 数组中的第一个元素将被视为主标签。

items.source: If this annotation is present, all labels present on a node and not statically mapped via @Node and the class names, will be collected into that collection during load. During writes, all labels of the node will be replaced with the statically defined labels plus the contents of the collection.
items.translation: 如果存在此注解，则在加载过程中，节点上所有未通过 `@Node` 和类名进行静态映射的标签将被收集到该集合中。 在写入时，节点的所有标签将被替换为静态定义的标签加上该集合的内容。

items.source: While @Node creates a mapping between a class and nodes having a specific label, we also need to make the connection between individual instances of that class (objects) and instances of the node.
items.translation: 虽然 `@Node` 在类与具有特定标签的节点之间建立了映射，但我们还需要建立该类（对象）的单个实例与节点实例之间的连接。

items.source: We therefore support two different kind of surrogate keys.
items.translation: 因此，我们支持两种不同类型的代理键。

items.source: All attributes of a @Node-annotated class will be persisted as properties of Neo4j nodes and relationships. Without further configuration, the name of the attribute in the Java or Kotlin class will be used as Neo4j property.
items.translation:
`@Node` 注解类的所有属性都将持久化为 Neo4j 节点和关系的属性。  
在没有进一步配置的情况下，Java 或 Kotlin 类中属性的名称将用作 Neo4j 属性名。

items.source: You must define a property for the generated, internal ID (@RelationshipId) so that SDN can determine during save which relationships can be safely overwritten without losing properties. If SDN does not find a field for storing the internal node id, it will fail during startup.
items.translation: 您需要为生成的内部 ID（@RelationshipId）定义一个属性，以便 SDN 在保存时能够确定哪些关系可以安全地覆盖而不会丢失属性。如果 SDN 找不到用于存储内部节点 ID 的字段，则在启动时将失败。

items.source: The following annotations are used to specify conversions and ensure backwards compatibility with OGM.
items.translation: 以下注解用于指定转换并确保与 OGM 的向后兼容性。

items.source: To map an Object to nodes in the graph and vice versa, we need a label to identify the class to map to and from.
items.translation: 要将对象映射到图中的节点，反之亦然，我们需要一个标签来标识用于映射的类。

items.source: The primary label should always be the most concrete label that reflects your domain class.
items.translation: 主要标签应始终是最具体的、能够反映您领域类的标签。

items.source:
For each instance of an annotated class that is written through a repository or through the Neo4j template, one node in the graph with at least the primary label will be written.
Vice versa, all nodes with the primary label will be mapped to the instances of the annotated class.
items.translation: 对于通过仓储或 Neo4j 模板写入的每个已标注类的实例，将在图中写入一个具有至少主标签的节点。反之，所有具有主标签的节点都将被映射到该已标注类的实例。

items.source: We also support interfaces in domain-class-hierarchies for some scenarios:
items.translation: 我们也在某些场景下支持领域类层次结构中的接口：

items.source: Using a different primary label instead of the interface name is possible, too:
items.translation: 也可以使用不同的主标签代替界面名称：

items.source:
It’s also possible to use different implementations of an interface and have a polymorph domain model.
When doing so, at least two labels are required: A label determining the interface and one determining the concrete class:
items.translation:
同样，也可以使用接口的不同实现并构建多态领域模型。  
在这种情况下，至少需要两个标签：一个用于确定接口，另一个用于确定具体类：

items.translation: 所需的数据结构如下测试所示：

items.source:
Natural keys are however pretty hard to find.
Peoples names for example are seldom unique, change over time or worse, not everyone has a first and last name.
items.translation: 然而，自然键很难找到。例如，人名通常不唯一，会随时间变化，或者更糟的是，并非每个人都有名和姓。

items.translation: 关系属性类及其用法可能如下所示：

items.source:
In general there is no limitation of relationships / hops for creating the queries.
SDN parses the whole reachable graph from your modelled nodes.
items.translation:
通常情况下，创建查询时没有对关系/跳数的限制。  
SDN 会解析您建模节点所能到达的整个图。

items.source:
This said, when there is the idea of mapping a relationship bidirectional, meaning you define the relationship on both ends of your entity,
you might get more than what you are expecting.
items.translation: 话虽如此，当您将关系定义为双向映射（即在实体的两端都定义该关系）时，您可能会得到超出预期的结果。

items.translation:
将所有这些组合在一起，我们可以创建一个简单的领域。
我们使用电影和具有不同角色的角色：

items.source: 1 @Node is used to mark this class as a managed entity. It also is used to configure the Neo4j label. The label defaults to the name of the class, if you’re just using plain @Node. 2 Each entity has to have an id. We use the movie’s name as unique identifier. 3 This shows @Property as a way to use a different name for the field than for the graph property. 4 This configures an incoming relationship to a person. 5 This is the constructor to be used by your application code as well as by SDN.
items.translation: 1 @Node 用于将此类标记为托管实体。它还可用于配置 Neo4j 标签。如果您仅使用普通的 @Node，则标签默认为类的名称。 2 每个实体都必须具有一个 id。我们使用电影的名称作为唯一标识符。 3 这展示了 @Property 的用法，即可以使用与图属性不同的名称来命名字段。 4 此配置用于指向某人的入向关系。 5 这是您的应用程序代码以及 SDN 将使用的构造函数。

items.source: If you have other applications add additional labels to nodes, don’t use @DynamicLabels. If @DynamicLabels is present on a managed entity, the resulting set of labels will be "the truth" written to the database.
items.translation: 如果您有其他应用程序，请在节点上添加额外的标签，不要使用 @DynamicLabels。 如果托管实体上存在 @DynamicLabels，则生成的标签集合将被写入数据库，成为“唯一真相”。

items.source: We haven’t modelled the relationship between movies and people in both direction. Why is that? We see the MovieEntity as the aggregate root, owning the relationships. On the other hand, we want to be able to pull all people from the database without selecting all the movies associated with them. Please consider your application’s use case before you try to map every relationship in your database in every direction. While you can do this, you may end up rebuilding a graph database inside your object graph and this is not the intention of a mapping framework. If you have to model your circular or bidirectional domain and don’t want to fetch the whole graph, you can define a fine-grained description of the data that you want to fetch by using projections.
items.translation: 我们尚未对电影与人物之间的双向关系进行建模。这是为什么呢？ 我们将 MovieEntity 视为聚合根，由其拥有这些关系。 另一方面，我们希望能够从数据库中检索所有人物，而无需同时加载与他们关联的所有电影。 在尝试将数据库中的每个关系以每个方向进行映射之前，请充分考虑您应用程序的使用场景。 虽然您可以这样做，但这可能会导致在对象图中重建一个图数据库，而这并非映射框架的初衷。 如果您必须对循环或双向领域进行建模，但不想获取整个图， 您可以通过使用 投影 来定义所需数据的细粒度描述。
